title: Family nicknames: Mealy, Boose and Polo
summary: He names his brother Andrew (Boose) and explains New Orleans nicknames, including being called Polo for Paul.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Now Mealy, he's just about ten years, pretty near ten years older than me.
What was your other brother's name? My other brother was named Andrew. Andrew. Andrew.

Andrew Barnes. We used to call him, everybody called him Boose. Boose? Yeah, Boose. It was B-O-S-E Boose. Nicknames were very popular in New Orleans at that time. And Mealy, his name is Emil. They called him Mealy. And my name being Paul, they called me Polo. Well Polo is just the same as Paul. Yeah, I understand. Everybody by the name of Paul during those times, they called him Polo.
Once Polo's there. And I remember on in Ron Wallens, it was like you, someone named Richard and you called him Dick or James, Jim, you know so forth. You understand?
